soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 / class nonemptiness
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed derivation of c_X≤1≤C_X is circular: ass:context-density only constrains a law already in the class, so it cannot establish compatibility before the theorem proves a witness exists; add c_X≤1≤C_X as a parameter-domain assumption.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves a finite-arm regret versus treatment-effect estimation-error Pareto tradeoff; Theorem 5 gives a finite-sample error bound for its nominated estimator, rather than a minimax result over all honest confidence intervals.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 713–742, abstract and main theorem discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies the optimal-treatment-rule value, gives a necessary-and-sufficient pathwise-differentiability condition, and discusses root-n inference under stated conditions; it does not optimize sequential data collection under welfare cost.

source_verification_receipts.locator: abstract; Section 4, Margin Condition and Higher-Order Dominance
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops one-sided lower confidence bands for optimal welfare and analyzes the role of a margin condition; it does not study adaptive welfare-budgeted data collection or two-sided uniform honest width.

The paper proves stability, a Wald CLT for fixed linear functionals, and a near-minimax regret guarantee for penalized EXP4; this is orthogonal to uniform nonregular honest-width inference under a hard welfare budget.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add the primitive parameter-domain condition c_X≤1≤C_X and make the nonemptiness theorem invoke it directly; retain integration only after constructing P^dagger.

Inspect and cite the final 2013 Annals version of Perchet–Rigollet at its exact theorem and assumption locators, then either prove the Gaussian transfer or weaken Theorem 3 to the published bounded/sub-Gaussian regime with any unavoidable logarithms made explicit.

Sharpen the flagship OEQ into a first explicit branch claim—for example at d=1, β=1, α=1/5, rho asymptotic to T^(3/5)—with a named target rate and a matched lower/upper route before asserting a complete transition map.

recommended_next_step: Repair the density-constant compatibility gap, verify the exact published Perchet–Rigollet theorem before retaining the Gaussian feasibility equivalence, then advance the repaired frontier kernel to Stage 0.
